headline: Brazil Government Decree Divides Critical Minerals Into Three Priority Levels
summary: President Lula signed a regulation dividing critical and strategic minerals into three priority levels, covering applications from electric vehicle batteries to defense infrastructure.
why: Critical mineral regulations dictate state priorities, resource allocation, and industrial policies for sectors essential to the global energy transition and advanced manufacturing.

impacts.name: Mining Sector
impacts.why: Government prioritization impacts investment and development timelines for critical mineral extraction.
